# Ordinary vector accent references

`generate_vector_accents.cjs` loads the unmodified SHA-pinned MathJax3.2.2 assets embedded in D2 v0.8.1. It uses a fresh VM for every expression/mode and records complete SVG hashes and dimensions derived from serialized ex sizes. The optional third argument saves the actual original SVG files. The44 cases cover short/long vec bases, bold/Physics scopes and aliases, nested/script vectors, the combined annotated brace formula, and ordinary/wide/over-arrow controls.

Thirty-eight actual SVG outputs must exactly match the primary references. Six named existing residual controls are not primary parity claims: widehat/widetilde retain D046's different glyphs/placement/bounds, while the combined brace expression retains D047's one-unit vec translation difference. Their actual baseline SVG bytes and dimensions are preserved in `vector_accent_unchanged_residuals.json`, from parent c22e621 (the same tree as accepted merge9d8ebeed). Tests require exact byte-for-byte baseline equality, preserve and cross-check the unchanged primary hashes, and constrain the six residual names/issues. Original strict44-case failures and baseline/candidate/original SVGs remain in review evidence. No coordinate fitting, SVG normalization or tolerance is used.

The one-line production correction follows BaseMappings.vec and BaseMethods.Accent at MathJax commit ad8f5c21cb810236551da8c6512ba733e67357ee: ordinary vec omits the stretchy flag, so Accent writes false; widehat/widetilde explicitly pass true. Dedicated compiler controls require that exact boolean policy. The inherited96-case Physics suite now enforces all96 complete SVGs and exact vec stretchy attributes: its former six D045 rendering exceptions and vec-tree qualification are removed. Only inherited non-rendering mover/mstyle metadata qualifications remain.
